sources_consulted.found: Tsamdrak edition: Hanson-Barber gave English title/colophons catalog; THDL expanded it — these are scholarly finding aids, not translations of the Tibetan dkar chag
Confirmed Tsamdrak = mTshams brag monastery in Bhutan; 'one of the only complete sets of Nyingma Gyubum was found here'; no mention of dkar chag English translation

Arguillère 2022: English-language finding aid with French annotations listing mTshams brag tantras — a scholarly catalog, not a translation of the Tibetan dkar chag text (HTTP 403, confirmed via search snippets)
Notes a dkar chag 'Rnying rgyud Dkar chag' by Kah thog Tshe dbang mchog grub; no English translation found; scholarly English catalogs are finding aids only
BDRC: Tsamdrak manuscript of rNying ma'i rgyud 'bum (Sangs rgyas gling, Tawang) — 47 volumes Tibetan; note that 'much of the dkar chag has been lost'; no English translation mentioned
BDRC: 'rnying ma rgyud bum gyi dkar chag gsal ba'i me long' — Tibetan dkar chag of the Sde dge edition (not Tsamdrak), in Tibetan, published 2000; no English translation

Cantwell, Mayer et al. (2006): English illustrated inventory of Rig 'dzin Tshe dbang nor bu edition — a different edition from Tsamdrak; no Tsamdrak dkar chag translation
Mandala/Virginia: confirms Tsamdrak as one of five Bhutanese Nyingma Gyubum manuscripts; no dkar chag translation information
